title: The Membership Observatory
prompt: Use Dazzler to design the membership observatory for its fictional reader task. A dark plotting wall gives the trend the full width; measure switches sit in a slim rail and the exact ledger follows below. Retain the existing data and functional controls, with keyboard and mobile access. Use Young Serif, #8A274F and #FFF2B8. Preserve factual caveats and local-only behavior; do not imply real booking, payment, publication or account changes.
